changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 11: ProviderRegistry.register(descriptor) and registerImplementation(id, implementation: unknown) collapse into one register(descriptor, implementation?: ProviderImplementation) call, typing the implementation argument as AgentRuntimeProvider<unknown> | ChannelProvider<unknown> instead of unknown. register() now recognizes completion of a pre-registered descriptor (the exact same object, not a duplicate) so a builtin descriptor registered before its package loads can still be completed with its implementation in one call; calling register() twice with two distinct descriptor objects for the same id still throws DuplicateProviderError as before. Updated the two call sites that paired the old two calls: registry/provider-loader.ts's loadOneProviderPackage and registry/builtins.ts's registerBuiltinProvider (and plugin/loader.ts's contribute(), which feeds the latter, is typed the same way instead of unknown). getImplementation() and createBuiltinProviderRegistry()'s pre-registration of builtin descriptors (no implementation yet) are unchanged; this is a write-side typing and call-site consolidation only, no change on any production path.
